versions.changelog:
- Initial release of feishu-voice-message.
- Generate Feishu-compatible voice messages (with waveform) from text and auto-convert to OPUS format for direct playback in chat.
- Supports multiple voice presets for both adult and child voices.
- Command-line usage and agent integration provided.
- Requires Edge TTS and FFmpeg for audio generation and conversion.
- Enforces OPUS as the output format to ensure optimal in-chat playback on both mobile and desktop.
